feat(forms): a rental's page in the drawing's words, its deposit reset with a short rate period, and business property types for commercial categories (D-109) (#4476)

* feat(forms): a rental's page in the drawing's words, its deposit reset with a short rate period, and business property types for commercial categories (D-109 parts 7 and 8)

The founder's answers of 15 November (D-109):
- A rental's terms read as the drawing words them (renderRentTerms, post-ad-sell-deltas.html:7852-7855): "Security
  deposit" before "Minimum term" (and "Maximum term", its pair), "None" for no deposit, "2× the monthly rent ·
  refundable" and "J$50,000 · refundable". The form's "On your listing page" box reads the same rows.
- Changing the rate to an hour, a day or a week resets a "Multiples of rent" deposit to "Not stated", as the drawing's
  syncDeposit does (:7744-7749). Only on the poster's change, in the same update as the term units that follow the
  period (a test proves neither change undoes the other); a listing that opens that way is never changed by opening it.
- Commercial Properties, Offices, Shops & Booths and Warehouses & Storage offer Office, Retail, Warehouse, Land and
  Other; the home categories keep the home types. The commercial list is the Real Estate structure rule's (ISS-9404),
  so the two can't drift. Dry count: no public listing on the dev site sits in those four categories.
